title: 20-Layer Asymmetric FP with Linear Chirp Seeding and ±5 nm Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: The score collapse in iteration_09 resulted from over-constrained thickness bounds (±4 nm) preventing optimizer escape from a poor local minimum. Seeding optimization from a quarter-wave-based thickness profile with an imposed linear chirp across central layers 1-12, combined with wider ±5 nm relaxation bounds, will enable the optimizer to explore convex directions hinted at by tail-layer expansions while breaking residual periodicity that limits stopband suppression.
design_principle: Controlled monotonic drift (linear chirp) applied to seed thicknesses breaks strict quarter-wave periodicity in the stack center, allowing gradient-based optimization to discover non-quarter-wave thickness distributions that improve both passband transmission and stopband rejection simultaneously.
proposed_topology: 20 finite layers total, alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 sequence starting with Ta2O5 (layer 1) on Fused Silica substrate, air incident medium. Layers 1-12 receive linear chirp seed perturbation; layers 13-20 retain base quarter-wave thicknesses as seed.
design_variables: layer thicknesses (20 variables, seeded from quarter-wave profile with chirp applied to layers 1-12)
thickness bounds ±5.0 nm around seeded values
soft_objectives: minimize mean transmittance in 1400-1500 nm stopband
minimize mean transmittance in 1600-1700 nm stopband
maintain physical validity (positive thicknesses, no absorption)
manufacturing_considerations: ±5 nm thickness tolerance represents realistic deposition control
theory_basis: Defective DBR bandpass filter principle (evidence 279797769): non-quarter-wave thickness optimization can create transmission peaks with sideband suppression
Needle optimization with gradual evolution (evidence 225461372): merit function targeting specific spectral ranges handles multi-wavelength targets
Edge filter sensitivity to small index variations (evidence 7970030): narrow transition zones require precise thickness control
expected_advantages: Wider bounds (±5 nm vs ±4 nm) allow optimizer to escape local minimum
Linear chirp seed breaks periodicity that may limit stopband performance
Directly implements feedback directive mechanistic insight
known_risks: Chirp magnitude may be insufficient to escape poor basin if seed is too far from optimum
Linear chirp may not match optimal thickness distribution shape
20 layers may be insufficient for dual stopband suppression with high passband transmission
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer planar dielectric filter stack with alternating Ta2O5 and SiO2 layers on Fused Silica substrate, air incident medium. Layer sequence: Ta2O5(1), SiO2(2), Ta2O5(3), SiO2(4), Ta2O5(5), SiO2(6), Ta2O5(7), SiO2(8), Ta2O5(9), SiO2(10), Ta2O5(11), SiO2(12), Ta2O5(13), SiO2(14), Ta2O5(15), SiO2(16), Ta2O5(17), SiO2(18), Ta2O5(19), SiO2(20). Seed thicknesses as follows: layers 1-12 start from base quarter-wave values (Ta2O5 ≈153 nm, SiO2 ≈263 nm) with linear chirp perturbation applied: layer 1 receives +0.5 nm offset, layer 12 receives -0.5 nm offset, with linear interpolation for layers 2-11. Layers 13-20 use base quarter-wave values (Ta2O5 ≈153 nm, SiO2 ≈263 nm, layer 20 ≈266 nm). Set optimization bounds to ±5.0 nm around each seeded thickness value. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Evaluate transmittance spectrum at normal incidence (0 degrees), unpolarized or both s and p polarizations. Score objectives: (1) mean transmittance at 1550 nm wavelength (single point), (2) mean transmittance across 1400-1500 nm band, (3) mean transmittance across 1600-1700 nm band. Target: maximize 1550 nm transmission, minimize both stopband transmissions. Total layer count fixed at 20. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1400-1500 nm, 1550-1550 nm, 1600-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance at 1550 nm (soft target ≥ 0.95); strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 1400-1500 nm; transmittance in 1600-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30.
revision_reason: Iteration_09 score collapsed to 0.0196 due to over-constrained ±4 nm bounds preventing optimizer escape from poor local minimum. This route implements feedback directive: seed from quarter-wave profile, apply linear chirp to central 12 layers, widen bounds to ±5.0 nm to enable exploration of convex directions hinted at by tail-layer expansions in iteration_02.
